staircase_relevance.notes: Baseline for staircase installation supplies. Softwood strings, MDF/plywood, fixings, plasterboard for under-stair. Not first choice for premium hardwood treads.
Trade-focused general merchant. Strong for structural timber and installation supplies. Trade account is meaningful because pricing is not published to walk-ins.

parent_group: Huws Gray Ltd (formerly Grafton brands + Ridgeons)

staircase_relevance.notes: Strong local-branch network especially in rural areas. Timber + kitchens + landscaping combination makes them useful for whole-project supply.
Trade-warehouse format — walk in, pick from stock, drive out. Good for last-minute or missing-part supply during install. Priced for trade customers.
General trade merchant. Comparable to Jewson at branch level. Now part of the Huws Gray group after the Grafton restructure.
Independent-style national — branches often locally-managed with more product flexibility than the big three.
South West specialist. Regional strength for Devon/Somerset/Dorset staircase work.
East England regional merchant, now under Huws Gray.
Essex/London regional — useful for outdoor staircase timber and general supply.
Wales regional merchant — first-choice for Welsh staircase installers who want a local supplier.
Kent/Sussex regional with joinery focus — better than most generalists for staircase components.
Strong timber and joinery focus — carries hardwood for staircase treads and matching doors.
NW England specialist. Better timber selection than generalists in Liverpool / Chester area.
West Yorkshire timber and joinery specialist.
Premier NI timber and joinery merchant. First choice for oak staircase components in Northern Ireland.
NI general trade merchant.
NI trade merchant.
Independent general merchant. Useful for local Smethwick / West Midlands trade needs.
NW London independent — carries timber and installation products for local trade.
Central London independent — fast material sourcing for London staircase installs.
London trade warehouse — strong for staircase repair, MDF risers, fixings and under-stair projects. Broad range in one stop.
Premier timber merchant across North England and Midlands. First choice for oak and walnut staircase components in Leeds / Manchester / Bolton.
National hardwood distributor. Species range and machining service make them a first-call supplier for premium staircase work.
Premium hardwood and veneer specialist. Ideal for luxury staircase work — oak, walnut, ash, decorative veneered boards for risers and under-stair panelling.
The go-to national supplier for 9mm veneer sheets in every species. Directly supports the slab-plus-moulding back-panel construction method.
Premium hardwood specialist. Access to exotic species for bespoke luxury staircases.
Structural and engineered timber specialist. Useful for stringers on large staircases needing engineered timber for stability.
Scotland's premier timber merchant. First choice for staircase timber in the central belt.
Scotland premium timber supplier with engineered timber for stair manufacture.
Greater Manchester timber supplier — good breadth of hardwood and softwood for local staircase work.
South East premium timber — strong for oak staircase treads, handrails and feature components.
Joinery-grade timber supplier — oak stair stock plus general joinery timber.
Regional independent — postcode branch finder.
Specialist plywood supplier. Birch ply is a premium alternative to MDF for painted risers.
Plywood and marine ply specialist — needed for staircases in wet environments (bathroom stairs, external stairs).
Every staircase install needs the specific stair fixings, construction adhesive and 23-gauge pins Screwfix stocks. Near-universal UK coverage means one is always nearby.
Alternative to Screwfix. Same day pickup for missing fixings during staircase install.
Trade-only fixings brand. Stair-specific screw ranges. Available through most builders merchants.
The UK's most widely-stocked stair-parts brand. Available through Wickes, B&Q, most merchants. First choice for DIY stair upgrades and renovation part replacement.
Alongside Burbidge, one of the two dominant UK stair-parts brands. Strong on oak components and renovation-focused kits.
Online-first stair supplier. Configurable staircase orders — measure and order from web without a workshop visit. Suits DIY and small-builder trade.
Bespoke staircase manufacturer with UK-wide delivery. Alternative to using a local workshop when the customer wants a specific quoted product.
Custom stair manufacturer focused on contemporary designs.
Traditional bespoke staircase maker. Craft-focused, appropriate for period properties and heritage projects.
One of the UK's largest volume staircase manufacturers. Primarily serves house-builders — not the first choice for one-off bespoke residential.
Manufacturer plus installation service — end-to-end supply.
Bespoke manufacturer covering modern and traditional designs including glass systems.
Luxury bespoke manufacturer — architect and interior-designer channel focus.
The global-brand glass hardware supplier. Trade-account first — most professional glass balustrade installers specify CRL.
Premium glass railing system supplier — used on commercial and high-end residential projects. Complete system approach (glass + hardware + design).
Broad range of balustrade hardware including traditional wrought iron alongside modern glass and stainless systems.
Custom balustrade system supplier.
Metal stock supplier — cut-to-size stainless and aluminium for custom balusters and metal stair components.
Small-quantity metal supplier with cutting service — good for one-off custom staircase metal parts.
Structural steel supplier — needed for cantilever floating stair stringers and engineered steel supports.
Independent timber and machining specialist on the Wales/Herefordshire border. Machining service is the differentiator — most independents do not offer this.
South East multi-branch trade merchant. Useful for basic installation supplies across Kent/London/Essex/Surrey.
East and North London independent — general trade needs for London staircase installers.
Kent regional timber and general trade — useful mixed supplier for joinery-heavy staircase work.
Bristol timber merchant with cutting service and ironmongery counter — useful all-in-one for South West stair repairs and small joinery.
Halifax-based supplier covering both modern and traditional stair systems. Broad species range (oak, pine, beech, ash, walnut) is unusual for a regional merchant.
Trade-focused stair parts supplier — Essex base with UK-wide delivery. Alternative distribution channel to Burbidge/Cheshire Mouldings.
National tool hire network. First choice for floor sanders (refinishing stair treads), dust extractors, scaffold towers for high stairwells and specialist SDS drills for masonry-fixing handrails.
Alternative national to HSS. Same category coverage.
TP branch integrated tool hire — pick up hire kit at the same time as materials. Trade account crosses over.
Online-first hire aggregator — delivery-based rather than local branch.
Coventry/Midlands regional hire — local alternative to nationals for trade customers.
Small-to-medium workshop machinery. Right tier for a starter or one-person staircase workshop (£5-25k kit).

Industrial-tier machinery for mid-to-large staircase manufacturers. Format4 is Felder's premium range used by high-end joinery. Training and service support make them the standard choice above £25k workshop kit.
The mainstream small-workshop supplier. Where a one-person or starter staircase business buys most of its kit — competitive with Record Power at the entry tier.
Industrial woodworking machinery for volume staircase manufacturers. 5-axis capability is what enables curved-stair production.
Alternative to SCM at the industrial CNC tier. Both are used by large UK staircase factories for volume and curved-stair work.
Mid-tier CNC router brand. Good fit for medium workshops making the step from manual to CNC production.
CNC cutting systems — competitor to AXYZ in the mid-tier.
The universal CAD supplier. AutoCAD for 2D technical drawings, Fusion 360 for CAD/CAM (drives CNC), Revit for architects who need BIM. Most staircase companies use at least one.
Engineering-grade 3D CAD. Used more for metal staircase design and cantilever engineering than everyday timber work.
Dedicated staircase design software — calculations, drawings, CNC output. Right software for small-to-medium workshops that do not need Compass or Staircon's industrial scale.
Professional-grade staircase production software. Used by UK's larger stair manufacturers. Full workflow from customer measurements to CNC output.
Dedicated stair design + manufacturing platform. Rival to Compass Software at the industrial tier — Nordic origin, strong UK adoption.
The dominant hardwax oil brand in UK premium joinery. Osmo Polyx Oil is a default finish choice for oak and walnut staircase treads — durable, natural look, spot-repairable.
UK-based finishing brand. Alternative to Osmo — often chosen by craftsmen who prefer a UK supplier or slightly warmer sheen.
Single-coat plant-based oil in a wide colour range. Popular with premium workshops for the one-application efficiency and colour precision.
UK lacquer specialist. Waterborne and solvent lacquers for professional spray-booth workshops.
Floor-industry grade finishes that transfer directly to stair treads. Waterborne lacquers popular for their durability and low VOC.
Better known for external woodwork — some use on painted interior stairs and coloured stains.
The UK's dominant online ironmongery specialist. Next-day delivery for stair-specific brackets, connectors and handrail fittings.
UK trade ironmongery — alternative to Ironmongery Direct.
Useful when coordinating stair balustrade metalwork with adjacent door hardware for a cohesive look.
